name: Powell Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench, holding a dumbbell with the top arm.
Raise the dumbbell in an arc from hip to overhead.
The path combines a lateral raise with external rotation.
Lower slowly. A rear-delt and rotator-cuff hybrid.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: Powell Raise is an intermediate pulling exercise for the rear delts, performed with dumbbells. Pulling balances all the pressing we do in life and keeps the upper back and posture strong.
